title: Clinical Note Soap
description: Clinical Note Soap contract normalized from the DocuBricks Healthcare library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-healthcare-clinical-note-soap
  title: Clinical Note Soap
  description: Clinical Note Soap contract normalized from the DocuBricks Healthcare library.
  version: healthcare_clinical_note_soap_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: healthcare/clinical_note_soap
    sourcePath: Schemas/healthcare/clinical_note_soap
    sourceVersion: healthcare_clinical_note_soap_v1
    sourceDigest: fefd213a0b50b40a7b7df436398c2c6241b112e1241a13e3ba833e477be5b385
spec:
  documentType: clinical_note_soap
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - note-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - assessment-diagnoses
        - bp
        - chief-complaint
        - department
        - description
        - document-id
        - follow-up-instructions
        - follow-up-timeframe
        - hr
        - icd10-code
        - medications-mentioned
        - note-type
        - objective-vitals
        - patient-dob
        - patient-mrn
        - plan-summary
        - provider-npi
        - provider-specialty
        - rr
        - spo2
        - subjective-summary
        - temp
        - weight
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - facility-name
        - patient-name
        - provider-name
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - status
  fields:
    - id: note-date
      name: note_date
      label: Note Date
      description: Date the note was authored/signed, format YYYY-MM-DD
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/note_date
    - id: note-type
      name: note_type
      label: Note Type
      description: "Type of clinical note. One of: Progress | Discharge | Consultation | Admission"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/note_type
    - id: document-id
      name: document_id
      label: Document Id
      description: Electronic Medical Record (EMR) note identifier or encounter number if present
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/document_id
    - id: provider-name
      name: provider_name
      label: Provider Name
      description: Full name of the clinician authoring the note (e.g., "Dr. Sarah Chen, MD")
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/provider_name
    - id: provider-npi
      name: provider_npi
      label: Provider Npi
      description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the authoring provider — 10-digit numeric; null if not
        embedded in note
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/provider_npi
    - id: provider-specialty
      name: provider_specialty
      label: Provider Specialty
      description: Clinical specialty or department of the provider (e.g., "Internal Medicine", "Emergency
        Medicine", "Orthopedics")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/provider_specialty
    - id: patient-name
      name: patient_name
      label: Patient Name
      description: Full name of the patient
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/patient_name
    - id: patient-dob
      name: patient_dob
      label: Patient Dob
      description: Patient date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/patient_dob
    - id: patient-mrn
      name: patient_mrn
      label: Patient Mrn
      description: Medical Record Number (MRN) assigned by the facility
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/patient_mrn
    - id: facility-name
      name: facility_name
      label: Facility Name
      description: Name of the hospital, clinic, or practice where the note was created
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/facility_name
    - id: department
      name: department
      label: Department
      description: Clinical department or unit (e.g., "Cardiology Outpatient Clinic", "Emergency Department",
        "2-North Med/Surg")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/department
    - id: chief-complaint
      name: chief_complaint
      label: Chief Complaint
      description: Patient's primary stated reason for visit in their own words or as paraphrased by provider. Free
        text, maximum 200 characters. Extract the most specific complaint from the "Chief Complaint" or "CC:"
        label
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/chief_complaint
    - id: subjective-summary
      name: subjective_summary
      label: Subjective Summary
      description: Summary of the full Subjective section including history of present illness (HPI), review of
        systems, and relevant history. Free text, maximum 300 characters. Truncate with ellipsis if longer
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/subjective_summary
    - id: objective-vitals
      name: objective_vitals
      label: Objective Vitals
      description: "Structured object containing vital signs. Extract each of the following sub-fields as a string
        value (include units). Set to null if not documented:"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/objective_vitals
    - id: bp
      name: bp
      label: Bp
      description: Blood pressure (e.g., "138/88 mmHg")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/bp
    - id: hr
      name: hr
      label: Hr
      description: Heart rate (e.g., "76 bpm")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/hr
    - id: temp
      name: temp
      label: Temp
      description: Temperature (e.g., "98.6°F" or "37.0°C")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/temp
    - id: rr
      name: rr
      label: Rr
      description: Respiratory rate (e.g., "16 breaths/min")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/rr
    - id: spo2
      name: spo2
      label: Spo2
      description: Oxygen saturation (e.g., "97% on room air")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/spo2
    - id: weight
      name: weight
      label: Weight
      description: Body weight (e.g., "185 lbs" or "83.9 kg")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/weight
    - id: assessment-diagnoses
      name: assessment_diagnoses
      label: Assessment Diagnoses
      description: "Array of diagnosis objects. For each diagnosis found in the Assessment section, extract:"
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/assessment_diagnoses
    - id: icd10-code
      name: icd10_code
      label: Icd10 Code
      description: ICD-10-CM code (e.g., "I10", "E11.9"). Null if only described without a code
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/icd10_code
    - id: description
      name: description
      label: Description
      description: Diagnosis description or name as written in the note
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/description
    - id: status
      name: status
      label: Status
      description: "One of: Active | Chronic | Resolved | New | Suspected (infer from context if not explicit)"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/status
    - id: plan-summary
      name: plan_summary
      label: Plan Summary
      description: Summary of the Plan section including medications prescribed/adjusted, orders placed, referrals,
        and instructions. Free text, maximum 300 characters. Truncate with ellipsis if longer
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/plan_summary
    - id: medications-mentioned
      name: medications_mentioned
      label: Medications Mentioned
      description: Array of medication names referenced anywhere in the note (including current medications list,
        new prescriptions, discontinued medications). Include drug name only — no dosing details
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/medications_mentioned
    - id: follow-up-instructions
      name: follow_up_instructions
      label: Follow Up Instructions
      description: Specific follow-up instruction text (e.g., "Return to clinic if fever > 101.5°F or worsening symptoms")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/follow_up_instructions
    - id: follow-up-timeframe
      name: follow_up_timeframe
      label: Follow Up Timeframe
      description: Time interval for scheduled follow-up (e.g., "2 weeks", "3 months", "as needed")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/follow_up_timeframe
  validationRules:
    - id: document-id-not-null
      severity: error
      description: Document/encounter ID is the EMR primary key for note attribution — without it the record cannot
        be linked to an encounter, clinician, or patient in downstream systems
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: document_id
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: document_id
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: document_id IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(document_id)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: avg-confidence-minimum
      severity: warning
      description: Overall extraction confidence below 0.60 indicates severe document quality issues (handwriting,
        fax artifacts, non-SOAP formatting) — route to clinical review queue rather than ingest
      rule:
        op: gte
        left:
          field: avg_confidence
        right:
          value: 0.6
      sourceExpression: avg_confidence >= 0.60
      supported: true
    - id: note-date-not-null
      severity: warning
      description: Note date is required for clinical timeline integrity, regulatory retention schedules, and
        quality measure date attribution; undated notes cannot be safely processed
      rule:
        op: present
        field: note_date
      sourceExpression: note_date IS NOT NULL
      supported: true
    - id: provider-name-not-null
      severity: warning
      description: Provider name is required for attribution, peer review routing, credentialing verification, and
        medical-legal documentation; anonymous notes must be quarantined
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: provider_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: provider_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: provider_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(provider_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: note-type-valid-enum
      severity: warning
      description: Note type must be a recognized clinical note category for downstream care management and quality
        reporting routing; unrecognized types flag for reclassification
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: note_type
            right:
              value: Progress
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: note_type
            right:
              value: Discharge
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: note_type
            right:
              value: Consultation
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: note_type
            right:
              value: Admission
      sourceExpression: note_type IN ('Progress', 'Discharge', 'Consultation', 'Admission')
      supported: true
    - id: chief-complaint-present
      severity: warning
      description: Chief complaint is a core clinical documentation element; its absence may indicate extraction
        failure or a structurally incomplete note requiring clinical review
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: chief_complaint
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: chief_complaint
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: chief_complaint IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(chief_complaint)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: assessment-diagnoses-present
      severity: warning
      description: At least one diagnosis must be present in the Assessment section for care coordination, billing
        code mapping, and quality measure attribution; absence flags documentation gap
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: assessment_diagnoses
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: assessment_diagnoses
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: assessment_diagnoses IS NOT NULL AND ARRAY_SIZE(assessment_diagnoses) > 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      note_date:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Note date is required for clinical timeline integrity, HIPAA minimum necessary documentation, and
          regulatory retention scheduling; incorrect dates create medical-legal liability
      provider_npi:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Provider NPI links note to credentialed clinician record for quality reporting, attestation
          workflows, and FHIR Practitioner resource matching; format validation is critical
      patient_mrn:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: MRN is the EMR patient master identifier; extraction errors cause wrong-patient note attribution —
          a patient safety event and HIPAA violation risk
      patient_dob:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Date of birth is a required patient identity verification field and is used for age-based clinical
          decision support; errors may cause mismatched records
      assessment_diagnoses:
        minConfidence: 0.8
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Diagnoses drive billing code generation, quality measure attribution, and care gap identification;
          clinical notes often use informal terminology requiring ICD-10 inference — lower threshold reflects
          this complexity
      objective_vitals:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Vital signs are critical for clinical decision support (e.g., sepsis alerts, hypertension
          management) and population health analytics; structured extraction must preserve units and values
          accurately
      chief_complaint:
        minConfidence: 0.82
        reviewOnBreach: false
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Chief complaint drives care pathway routing and patient communication; lower threshold acceptable
          as it is often free text in provider's words rather than a labeled field
      provider_name:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Provider name required for note attribution, medical staff credentialing verification, and peer
          review workflows; format variability (signature vs. header) reduces achievable confidence
      note_type:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: false
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Note type classification routes records to appropriate downstream workflows (discharge planning,
          consultation reply, admission H&P); misclassification is recoverable through human review
      medications_mentioned:
        minConfidence: 0.78
        reviewOnBreach: false
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Medication extraction from free-text clinical notes is inherently approximate due to abbreviations,
          brand/generic mixing, and contextual usage; lower threshold reflects extraction complexity
      follow_up_timeframe:
        minConfidence: 0.75
        reviewOnBreach: false
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Follow-up timeframe supports care gap and no-show tracking; acceptable at lower confidence as it is
          often embedded in narrative Plan text rather than a discrete field
      document_id:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Clinical Note SOAP extraction.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-dbrx-instruct
    maxTokens: 4096
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Clinical SOAP notes require deep medical terminology comprehension, ICD-10 code inference from
      narrative descriptions, structured extraction from free-form prose sections, and clinical reasoning to
      classify diagnosis status (Active/Chronic/Resolved/New/Suspected). Claude Sonnet excels at understanding
      nuanced clinical language, correctly mapping informal clinical shorthand to structured fields (e.g.,
      'HTN' to Essential hypertension, 'DM2' to Type 2 diabetes), and producing deterministic zero-temperature
      extractions essential for clinical data integrity. Temperature is set to 0.0 to eliminate hallucination
      risk — critical when generating ICD-10 codes that feed billing and quality programs. DBRX Instruct
      serves as fallback for well-structured EHR-exported notes with discrete labeled sections where medical
      reasoning depth is less critical.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      note_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the note was authored/signed, format YYYY-MM-DD
        format: date
      note_type:
        type: string
        description: "Type of clinical note. One of: Progress | Discharge | Consultation | Admission"
      document_id:
        type: string
        description: Electronic Medical Record (EMR) note identifier or encounter number if present
      provider_name:
        type: string
        description: Full name of the clinician authoring the note (e.g., "Dr. Sarah Chen, MD")
      provider_npi:
        type: string
        description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the authoring provider — 10-digit numeric; null if not
          embedded in note
      provider_specialty:
        type: string
        description: Clinical specialty or department of the provider (e.g., "Internal Medicine", "Emergency
          Medicine", "Orthopedics")
      patient_name:
        type: string
        description: Full name of the patient
      patient_dob:
        type: string
        description: Patient date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD
      patient_mrn:
        type: string
        description: Medical Record Number (MRN) assigned by the facility
      facility_name:
        type: string
        description: Name of the hospital, clinic, or practice where the note was created
      department:
        type: string
        description: Clinical department or unit (e.g., "Cardiology Outpatient Clinic", "Emergency Department",
          "2-North Med/Surg")
      chief_complaint:
        type: string
        description: Patient's primary stated reason for visit in their own words or as paraphrased by provider. Free
          text, maximum 200 characters. Extract the most specific complaint from the "Chief Complaint" or
          "CC:" label
      subjective_summary:
        type: string
        description: Summary of the full Subjective section including history of present illness (HPI), review of
          systems, and relevant history. Free text, maximum 300 characters. Truncate with ellipsis if longer
      objective_vitals:
        type: string
        description: "Structured object containing vital signs. Extract each of the following sub-fields as a string
          value (include units). Set to null if not documented:"
      bp:
        type: string
        description: Blood pressure (e.g., "138/88 mmHg")
      hr:
        type: string
        description: Heart rate (e.g., "76 bpm")
      temp:
        type: string
        description: Temperature (e.g., "98.6°F" or "37.0°C")
      rr:
        type: string
        description: Respiratory rate (e.g., "16 breaths/min")
      spo2:
        type: string
        description: Oxygen saturation (e.g., "97% on room air")
      weight:
        type: string
        description: Body weight (e.g., "185 lbs" or "83.9 kg")
      assessment_diagnoses:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: "Array of diagnosis objects. For each diagnosis found in the Assessment section, extract:"
      icd10_code:
        type: string
        description: ICD-10-CM code (e.g., "I10", "E11.9"). Null if only described without a code
      description:
        type: string
        description: Diagnosis description or name as written in the note
      status:
        type: string
        description: "One of: Active | Chronic | Resolved | New | Suspected (infer from context if not explicit)"
      plan_summary:
        type: string
        description: Summary of the Plan section including medications prescribed/adjusted, orders placed, referrals,
          and instructions. Free text, maximum 300 characters. Truncate with ellipsis if longer
      medications_mentioned:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Array of medication names referenced anywhere in the note (including current medications list,
          new prescriptions, discontinued medications). Include drug name only — no dosing details
      follow_up_instructions:
        type: string
        description: Specific follow-up instruction text (e.g., "Return to clinic if fever > 101.5°F or worsening
          symptoms")
      follow_up_timeframe:
        type: string
        description: Time interval for scheduled follow-up (e.g., "2 weeks", "3 months", "as needed")
    required:
      - note_date
      - document_id
      - provider_name
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: clinical_documents
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - note_date
          - document_id
          - provider_name
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - parties
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields: []
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
